name: Lost Souls
overview: Scripture reveals that lost souls are known and ordained by God even before birth, yet their hearts remain deceitful and desperately wicked apart from His intervention. Despite this, God's unfailing mercy and compassion offer cleansing and renewal from all sin and idolatry. The mission to reach the lost is clearly commanded, emphasizing belief and baptism as the means of salvation, while unbelief results in condemnation.
